cause.what: That commit is the FIX83/VF04 repair wave. It correctly stopped marking 1020EX paragraph 5 from family membership alone (the earlier VF04 ROUTE_OPTIONS FAIL at e5b6f7254) by adding isProsecutorConsentFinding() and a new refusal branch in selectionRefusal() in the shared host scripts/build-census-v1-ut_pet_acquittal-set.mjs.
cause.why_it_became_unclassified: The new branch named the refusal in a private vocabulary. It emitted kind 'court_finding_requires_prosecutor_evidence' and bespoke prose. For a selectionControls row the completeness reader takes the refusal class from category, then class, then kind (verify-packet-completeness.mjs line 197); 'court_finding_requires_prosecutor_evidence' is outside REFUSAL_CLASSES, and because the row uses no declared channel the unknown-class guard is skipped and classifyBlank falls through to the prose table. The new prose matched no entry in APPROVED_REASONS, so the blank landed on UNCLASSIFIED_BLANK. The row's own approvedBlankDisposition 'LATER_COMPLETION' could not save it: no script in the repository reads approvedBlankDisposition except the three builders that write it, so it is inert to the contract.
cause.why_vf04_did_not_see_it: vf04's PASS row at 6fb6e391b recorded commandReturnedNineZeros true; that is the one part of the row this lane could not reproduce. The field map at 6fb6e391b is byte-identical to the pre-repair bytes at df8da7ff7 (sha256 9713705c6e9f1940f94cd616c4c9cfdea384f75da34893c20157141a465fba29), and the completeness contract as it stood at 6fb6e391b, run directly on that row, also returns UNCLASSIFIED_BLANK. The only completeness change between 6fb6e391b and df8da7ff7 is 8ae2632bb, which added the source-presentation path this row does not enter. So the counter was already 1 when vf04 read, and the drift is the FIX83 finalizer change alone, not a later contract change. Every substantive VF04 proof-obligation finding was reproduced and none is disturbed by this repair.
